brand.name: BOSTANTEN
guidelines: Shopee affiliate promotion: disclose the affiliate link (e.g. #ad / link affiliate) wherever the platform requires it
Material is PU leather: always say 'kulit PU' or just 'tas', never 'kulit asli' or 'genuine leather'
Casual, honest creator tone; show the bag in real everyday use, no exaggeration
Only claims from verified_claims; everything else is [CLAIM NEEDED]

product.name: BOSTANTEN Wander Bag — Tas Selempang Mini 3 Cara Pakai
product.description: Compact PU-leather mini bag that can be carried three ways: by the hand strap, on the shoulder, or crossbody.
key_features: 3 ways to carry: hand strap, side (shoulder), crossbody
Zip closure with tassel pull; 1 zip compartment and 1 inner pocket (per listing)
visual_identity: Rounded, slightly crescent-shaped body that widens towards a flat base
Pebbled-grain finish in grey-brown (assumed to be the 'Elephant Grey' variant — confirm against the listing)
One-piece rounded top handle forming an oval opening
Small silver 'B' logo plate centred near the bottom of the front panel
Top zip with a long matching tassel pull on the left
Metal ring on each side where the long strap attaches

verified_claims.claim: Bisa dipakai 3 cara: tali tangan, samping (bahu), dan silang

Cocok untuk sekolah, kantor, jalan-jalan, belanja, makan, kencan, dan acara seperti pesta atau konser

prohibited_claims: Kulit asli / genuine leather / real leather
Waterproof, anti air, anti gores, or any durability or lifetime claim (not in the listing)
Capacity claims such as 'muat HP besar', 'muat botol', or a specific list of items (not in the listing; [CLAIM NEEDED])
'100% asli' / authenticity guarantees as a spoken claim (seller statement, not independently verified)
Prices, discounts, 'gratis ongkir' or limited-stock urgency (change often; not provided)
'Paling murah', 'terbaik', 'nomor satu' or comparisons with other brands
Saying it is a luxury or designer-brand bag

target_audience.description: Women — students, teens and office workers — looking for a compact, versatile everyday bag for school, work, hangouts and events
pain_points: One bag rarely suits both work and going out
Big bags feel heavy for short trips

campaign.objective: Click-through to the Shopee affiliate link
campaign.concept_direction: Natural creator moment showing the same bag carried three ways, filmed on a phone

deliverable.visual_style: Natural smartphone video, daylight, realistic, lightly handheld

mandatory_elements: Bag clearly visible within the first 2 seconds
Show at least two of the three carry styles
Spoken or on-screen CTA in the last 2 seconds
Affiliate disclosure added in editing or in the caption
restrictions: Only this BOSTANTEN bag: no other bags in frame (do not use female_02's reference.jpeg, which shows a cream bag)
